image_description: A small, juvenile hammerhead shark lying on a flat, grey surface (likely a boat deck or table). The shark is being held or stabilized by human hands visible at the top and bottom right. The shark displays the characteristic T-shaped cephalofoil, grey dorsal coloration, and white ventral side. There appears to be some minor redness or injury near the left eye/cephalofoil junction.
